create_kv_cache_manager: create a KVCacheManager instance to manage KV cache allocation and prefix caching for vLLM requests
allocate_slots_request: allocate KV cache slots for a request with new tokens, prefix cache hits, and lookahead tokens
get_computed_blocks_request: get the cached blocks and number of computed tokens for a request using prefix cache lookup
free_request_blocks: free all KV cache blocks allocated for a completed or preempted request
reset_prefix_cache: reset the KV cache prefix cache to invalidate cached blocks after weight updates
